comment: Screenshot scenes for Coral Bay Syndicate. Open game/index.html?shot=<name>&seed=1 in a browser: boot.js reads the name, scenes.js stages the moment, and the page sets window.__shotReady when it is time to capture at 1280x720.

1-chase.jpg.staging: Rico in a coral sedan at speed on a midtown avenue, wanted level 4, Interceptors in pursuit behind and a roadblock at the junction ahead, FIRST RUN objective on the HUD

2-drive.jpg.staging: Driving a taxi through the downtown glass canyon behind civilian traffic, DELIVERY objective on the HUD, minimap live

3-marina.jpg.staging: Rico on foot on the marina apron looking east over the piers and sailboats in the marina basin, HOT METAL objective on the HUD

4-combat.jpg.staging: Rico on foot at a downtown intersection at wanted level 3, Interceptors held at angles across the junction, pedestrians reacting to a recent gunshot
